visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of an infinity pool under a bright sky. In the foreground, a black baby stroller sits on a wooden deck. The background features modern high-rise glass buildings with a connecting bridge between two towers. (2) A woman with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and an olive-green skirt with a backpack, enters a room and smiles back at the camera. (3) The camera pans through a spacious hotel room featuring floor-to-ceiling windows with a view of a city, a river, and distant mountains. There is a gray sofa and a minimalist desk. (4) The woman is seen sitting on the sofa, holding a baby in her arms, looking out the large window. (5) A luxury bathroom is shown, featuring a large white freestanding bathtub positioned next to a glass wall with a city view. (6) The woman, now in a white button-down shirt and sunglasses, pushes the stroller along an outdoor tiled path near the pool area. (7) The woman is seen swimming in the infinity pool, looking towards the camera and smiling, with the skyscraper and blue sky in the background. (8) A modern glass chapel with an arched white frame is shown from the outside, followed by an interior shot with rows of gold-framed chairs. (9) The woman lounges on a pool-side chair under an umbrella while feeding the baby with a bottle. (10) Close-up shots show a baby crib with blue pillows, a white countertop sterilizer, and a baby bathtub placed inside the large hotel tub. (11) A modern spa area with dark stone walls and thermal pools is featured, followed by the wooden interior of a sauna room. (12) Night shots show the illuminated glass chapel and the infinity pool reflecting city lights from nearby buildings. (13) A baby sits in a high chair in a well-lit dining area. A long buffet counter with various food items and warm lighting is displayed. (14) The video concludes with the woman swimming in the pool as the sun shines on the water surface.
